Machine Learning: ModelPath

Machine Learning: ModelPath is a structured machine learning course app designed to help beginners learn machine learning from scratch — no prior experience needed.

Master core machine learning concepts through clear lessons, step-by-step algorithm explanations, Python code examples, interactive quizzes, practice exercises, algorithm comparison tools, model selection guidance, real datasets, and hands-on projects.

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN

Machine Learning Fundamentals
Supervised Learning & Unsupervised Learning
Model Evaluation & Feature Engineering
Linear Regression & Logistic Regression
Decision Trees & Random Forest
K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN)
Support Vector Machines (SVM)
K-Means Clustering & DBSCAN
Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
Gradient Boosting
Naive Bayes
Ridge, Lasso & Elastic Net
Hierarchical Clustering
Gaussian Mixture Models
Linear Discriminant Analysis
Isolation Forest
...and more ML algorithms, explained simply.

HOW IT WORKS

ModelPath follows a simple, proven learning flow:
Learn → Understand → Practice → Quiz → Apply → Build Projects

KEY FEATURES

• Structured machine learning courses for beginners
• Step-by-step ML algorithm explanations in plain language
• Python code examples for every algorithm
• Interactive quizzes and practice exercises
• Algorithm comparison tools — see which model fits your data
• Model selection guidance
• Real-world machine learning projects
• Downloadable practice datasets
• ML cheat sheets and a complete machine learning glossary
• Notes and bookmarks
• Learning progress tracking
• Light and dark themes
• Offline-friendly — learn anywhere, anytime

BUILD REAL PROJECTS

Apply your skills to practical machine learning projects: home price prediction, customer churn analysis, customer segmentation, credit risk scoring, fraud detection, and end-to-end machine learning pipelines.

PERFECT FOR

Students, beginners, aspiring data analysts, data scientists, developers, and anyone who wants to build a strong foundation in machine learning, data science, and artificial intelligence.

Start learning machine learning one step at a time with ModelPath — your pocket ML course.

Download now and take your first step into machine learning and AI.
